evidence: Reads the record pointer at input+0x110; if absent, returns 0xffffffff. If present, resolves its +0x48 record pointer (using the default record when null), reads a byte at that record plus selector x1 (helper returns 0xff for selectors above 5), sign-extends the byte, and returns it plus one. decompiled/main/main_0052.c:11801-11824; record helpers decompiled/main/main_0170.c:9347-9360, 19034-19041.

Loads a signed 16-bit value from the table pointer at global 0x700227e6f8 plus 0xbcf8. If input x1 is nonzero, queries attribute-context selector 4; when its low byte is below 9, returns the loaded value plus 9 minus that status. Otherwise returns the loaded value unchanged. decompiled/main/main_0166.c:23433-23456.

Queries attribute-context status selector 6, stores the returned low-byte value at the output pointer when it is below 3, and stores 0xffffffff when it is 3 or greater. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:30053-30069.

Calls format_attribute_value_for_display with the original inputs, then restores original input x3 into x0 and returns it. The helper performs the formatting work; this wrapper’s observable return is input x3. decompiled/main/main_0036.c:51486-51498; helper decompiled/main/main_0036.c:51500-51798.

Gets the global object at 0x7003abe158, calls state-initialization helpers, clears a 32-bit value at offset +0xc0 of the resulting object, then reads the object pointer at global +0x290 and passes it to load_roster_data. Returns zero. decompiled/main/main_0077.c:3163-3178; global getter decompiled/main/main_0071.c:21492-21498; helper decompiled/main/main_0071.c:27474-27498.
